source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: Use this ability when selecting the unit for **[close-quarters shooting](vsdata:core-rule/close-quarters-shooting)**. The unit may fire at targets it is **[engaged](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range)** with, and may disregard both **BS** modifiers and **[Hit roll](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls)** modifiers. You can turn off **[[BLAST]](vsdata:weapon-ability/blast)** weapon by weapon. A weapon using that option cannot fire at enemies **[engaged](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range)** by a different friendly unit.

detail.timing: selection to shoot using close-quarters shooting

blast.ifSuppressed: only enemy units not engaged with another friendly unit
